title: Indoor air quality during cooking and cleaning: a modelling case study in a residential kitchen evaluated with real-world reference instrument measurements

Indoor air pollution during cooking and cleaning is influenced by complex interactions between direct emissions, ventilation-driven outdoor/indoor exchange, deposition and chemical reactions on surfaces, and indoor chemical processing.
